title: Template update
body:
There are 29 changed files: 2 tooling, 1 mergeable, 13 seed and 13 net-new.

The biggest item is the i18n layer. It adds a new server hook, a root layout and a root page, and changes the build config and the package manifest. On top of that come a linter major version (schema migration), a test runner major version, a different deploy adapter, and a stricter directory limit.

My recommendation: defer this until the integration branch is merged. It collides with the same files.

questions.question: When should the template update land, given that it touches the same files as the integration branch?

options.label: Defer until the integration merges
options.description: Leave the template alone for now
